greeting: Good morning, Rick! Happy Saturday. Grab a coffee, there's a Texas rocket to watch this afternoon.

items.title: FAA lets flights resume after an hours-long nationwide ground stop
items.note: Every flight in the US was halted for hours Friday afternoon, stranding millions of travelers. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed overloaded, decades-old air traffic control equipment, and flights resumed Friday night.

items.title: Starship flight 15 reaches orbit, with a first-ever ship catch possible today
items.note: SpaceX's giant rocket launched from South Texas Friday and dropped off 26 Starlink satellites. If the ship passes its health checks, SpaceX will try to catch it with the launch tower around 3:15 PM Central today.

items.title: iOS 27.2 has two CarPlay improvements
items.note: If you listen to podcasts in the car, Apple Podcasts now has easy New Episodes and Continue Playing rows. Siri in CarPlay also got smarter and can remember things it told you before.

items.title: Early Black Friday Apple deals: AirTag 2 at an all-time low, AirPods Pro 3 $50 off
items.note: Amazon's early Black Friday sale has AirTag 2 down to $17.50 each and $50 off AirPods Pro 3, plus Apple Watch and MacBook Air discounts. Good stocking stuffer territory.

items.title: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
items.note: OpenAI now lets ChatGPT pick out items and finish the purchase for you, after you approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. For now it's only for a small group of paying Pro users in the US.

items.title: Slate Auto's 'Screenless GPS' is a good old road atlas
items.note: Slate's bare-bones electric pickup, aimed at under $25,000, skips the big touchscreen. Its answer to getting lost is a spiral-bound paper map, and Ars actually reviewed it.

items.title: James Webb telescope finds ice older than the star it orbits
items.note: Webb spotted water and carbon dioxide ice around a young star 64 light-years away, mixed much like the comets in our own solar system. It hints that the ingredients for watery planets may be common.

items.title: After 451,000 folds, the iPhone Duo's hinge is starting to fail
items.note: CNET built a machine to fold Apple's new foldable iPhone around the clock for three weeks. It still works, but now it no longer opens all the way flat.
